latestVersion.changelog:
Keyframes Video Editing 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches cloud-based AI video editing with detailed keyframe control.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB; outputs 1080p MP4.
- Automatic connection: checks/obtains NEMO_TOKEN, manages sessions, guides users through setup.
- Handles uploads, exports, credits, and timeline state actions with clear user prompts.
- Maps backend “GUI” responses to API actions and provides user-friendly status updates.
- Includes detailed error handling, timeline summaries, and actionable tips for efficient editing.
